properties.name: GPM Issues between the two design drawings.
properties.9709ba51-fcf7-0482-039a-caab42bfe071:
M6-08 shows the proton chilled water equipment having 717 GPM of flow with the Southland equipment having 50 GPM totalling 767 GPM.
MP8-013 and MP8-014 Shows that in the sequence that both HX can be used at the same time in a lead lag to provide the full flow to the system. Meaning there is no N+1 redundancy. 
MP6-001 shows the Chilled Water side of the heat exchangers as totaling 893.56 GPM.
Adding up all the values from the schedules leads to a value of 970.78 if all heat exchangers are at full capacity or 675.28 if they are N+1. Neither jives with the Southland drawings
If they are NOT N+1 then we are undersized in the pipe to the loop B heat exchangers as they should be 6" feeding the HX header and the floor piping should be 8" to handle the entire floor. The riser might also be undersized.
If they are N+1 then the HX header should be 5" not the 4" shown on the BR+/A drawings.
Either way I think we need an RFI to cover the full cost of the undersized pipe if my calculations are verified.
